muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿سبح﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿أنت﴾.
﴿اسم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ربك﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra, and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الأعلى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ربك﴾, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); or an adjective of ﴿اسم﴾, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as a second adjective (ṣifa) of al-rabb.
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". The clause ﴿خلق﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The object of khalaqa is omitted, i.e. "kulla shayʾ" (everything).
﴿فسوى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, a particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and sawwā is a past verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿خلق﴾, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿والذي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and alladhī is a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of the genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الذي﴾ in the previous ayah.
﴿قدر﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾. The clause ﴿قدر﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The object of qaddara is omitted, i.e. "kulla shayʾ" (everything).
﴿فهدى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, a particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and hadā is a past verb conjoined to ﴿قدر﴾, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿والذي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and alladhī is a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of the genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الذي خلق﴾.
﴿أخرج﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾. The clause ﴿أخرج﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿المرعى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فجعله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; jaʿala is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿غثاء﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿أحوى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿غثاء﴾, accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of al-marʿā, accusative by an implied fatḥa, i.e. He brought it forth dark green (aḥwā), black from the intensity of its greenness, then made it stubble after its dark greenness.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿سنقرئك﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position; nuqriʾuka is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu"; and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿تنسى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿تنسى﴾; the exception is emptied (mufarragh), from the most general of objects.
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma. The clause ﴿شاء الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of ﴿إن﴾. The clause of inna and what falls within its scope is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of what precedes it.
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". The clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿الجهر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and mā is a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to al-jahr, in the position of the accusative.
﴿يخفى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif. The clause ﴿يخفى﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ونيسرك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; nuyassiruka: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu"; and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Nuyassiruka is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿سنقرئك﴾.
﴿لليسرى﴾: the lām is a preposition indeclinable on the kasra, and al-yusrā is a noun in the genitive by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نيسرك﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿فذكر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and dhakkir is an imperative verb indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿إن﴾: conditional, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿نفعت﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿الذكرى﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿سيذكر﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and yadhdhakkar is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿يخشى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. The clause ﴿يخشى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ويتجنبها﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿سيذكّر﴾, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the pronoun refers to ﴿الذكرى﴾.
﴿الأشقى﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الأشقى﴾.
﴿يصلى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. The clause ﴿يصلى﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the fāʿil (agent) of yaṣlā is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾.
﴿النار﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿الكبرى﴾: a naʿt of ﴿النار﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the implied fatḥa, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿لا﴾: negative, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿يموت﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿فيها﴾: fī is a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn, and the pronoun is indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يموت﴾.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿يحيا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لا يموت﴾; it is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قد﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿أفلح﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿تزكى﴾: a past verb indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur). The clause ﴿تزكى﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وذكر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and dhakara is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تزكى﴾; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿اسم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ربه﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فصلى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ṣallā is a past verb indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, conjoined to ﴿ذكر﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿تؤثرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿الحياة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿الدنيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الحياة﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والآخرة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and al-ākhira is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿خير﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿وأبقى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and abqā is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿خير﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of inna.
﴿لفي﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) is a particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and fī is a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿الصحف﴾: a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الأولى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الصحف﴾, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma [Translator's note: so in the source; as a naʿt of the genitive ﴿الصحف﴾ it would be genitive by an implied kasra].

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿صحف﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿الصحف﴾ in the previous ayah, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote.
﴿وموسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and mūsā is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ibrāhīm, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra [Translator's note: so in the source; mūsā is normally treated as a diptote, whose genitive would be an implied fatḥa].
